subject: Brightleaf Health launch orientation and kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightleaf - handoff summary + proposed kickoff

Hi team —

Quick handoff note for Brightleaf Health (DL-2027-089-BH). High-level context: 
- Deal signed 2027-09-10. Committed start: Sept 21 pilot kickoff.
- Primary use case: low-latency clinical note summarization (batch + streaming).
- Expected QPS: ~12 peak, average ~4.
- Security: Brightleaf requested VPC option and SOC2 addendum in contract.

Key artifacts attached: Brightleaf_MA_20270914.pdf (signed master agreement), Brightleaf_SOW_v3.docx (SOW draft).

Ops & asks: 
1) Need CS primary and backup to own kickoff + 30d activation. Recommend naming owners by EOD today so I can introduce them to the Brightleaf team.
2) Technical pre-reqs: VPC peering, IP allowlist, and initial model choice — sales suggested redwood-llm-3b-quant for cost/latency. Please confirm any constraints.
3) Kickoff proposed: Tue Sep 21, 10:00 PT (60–75m). Please flag conflicts.

Marcus — can you confirm whether Dedicated or Hosted will be used for the pilot? Priyom — can you prepare a short run-of-show + preflight checklist if we lock the date? Grace — would you be able to be primary?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightleaf - handoff summary + proposed kickoff

Thanks Steph — quick answers inline:

- Dedicated vs Hosted: pilot will run on Hosted with a dedicated routing policy (no reserved pool) — ops confirmed capacity for their expected peak, we can switch to Dedicated if throughput grows.
- Model choice: redwood-llm-3b-quant is fine as a starting point; quantization tests planned during staging.
- Security: Ops has flagged the SOC2 addendum — legal is preparing a short addendum template we can attach to the MA. VPC peering is supported; engineering will need AKS/VPC IP ranges.

Owner suggestions: Grace primary, Priyom as backup (Grace has prior experience on clinical summarization pilots). I can support the technical preflight and coordinate with infra.

Action: Priyom, can you draft the run-of-show doc and preflight checklist by EOD tomorrow? I'll follow up with infra for IP blocks.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@brightleaf.health>, Roberto Diaz <rdiaz@brightleaf.health>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Brightleaf Health — kickoff proposal & CS introduction

Hi Sara & Roberto —

Thanks again for signing — we’re excited to get started. Introducing Grace O'Connor (cc) from our Customer Success team who will be your primary point for activation and the 30-day ramp. Marcus (cc) will cover technical preflight and infra coordination; Priyom (cc) will own the run-of-show and initial configuration checklist.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Sep 21, 10:00 AM PT (60–75m) — agenda draft attached (kickoff-agenda-Brightleaf.pdf). Draft agenda: intros, scope & success metrics, technical preflight (network & auth), demo of the pilot flow, timeline & owners, next steps.

Please confirm availability for Sep 21 and let us know who from procurement or security will join (we noticed an SOC 2 addendum note in the MA).

Attachments: Brightleaf_MA_20270914.pdf, kickoff-agenda-Brightleaf.pdf

Looking forward —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Sara Lee <sara@brightleaf.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Roberto Diaz <rdiaz@brightleaf.health>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightleaf.health>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightleaf Health — kickoff proposal & CS introduction

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — Sep 21 at 10am PT works for us. Emily (procurement) will join to confirm billing and contract logistics. A couple of initial asks from our side so CS/ops can prepare: 

- Do you support our SAML SSO provider (Okta)? We need a short SSO integration doc.
- Data retention: we need field-level retention settings and a 90-day retention default for test data.
- SOC 2 addendum — happy to sign, please send the addendum when ready.

On the agenda: can you include a short walkthrough of the token & cost controls so our finance team can understand throttles during the pilot?

Thanks,
Sara Lee
VP Product | Brightleaf Health
sara@brightleaf.health

Thanks — I’ll own this engagement as primary CS. Short plan & next steps: 

1) Run-of-show + preflight checklist: Priyom will finalize the doc today (will include VPC/VPN details, IP ranges, SSO checklist, token & cost control walkthrough).
2) Deliverables ahead of kickoff (by Sep 20 EOD): 
   - Priyom: Preflight checklist + run-of-show (doc)
   - Marcus: Confirm Hosted routing config and provide IP ranges for allowlist
   - Stephanie: Share SOC2 addendum when legal finishes it (we'll attach to MA)
3) Kickoff owner roster: Grace (CS primary), Priyom (CS backup & config), Marcus (Tech escalation), Stephanie (commercial/contact)
4) I'll prep a short kickoff slide set and include a 10-min token/cost-controls demo for finance.

Attachments: kickoff-agenda-Brightleaf.pdf (updated)

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invite for Sep 21 10:00 PT and include dial-in + Google Meet link.
